Name: RSV Summit Cellar (CP)
Author: LyzzCL
Description:
[size=3]Adds a cellar to the Summit House in the Ridgeside Village Expansion through Content Patcher. Cellar will only be available after renovation from Odd Jobs is done.

This is my first mod using Content Patcher, if there's any problem leave a comment with a list of mods you are using and if the console throw a message.

I wanted to add a cellar to my save on the Ridgeside Farm and so I thought of this as a good way to keep learning moding while adding something useful for myself. Keep in mind a cellar will be added in the future on a official update, so this in case you are desperate and want it now like me :p
[/size]
[size=4][b]Features:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][size=3]2 modest sized cellars, you can choose to add the extra floor through the config.[/size]
[*][size=3]An optional tunnel that connects this cellar with the vanilla farmhouse cellar.[/size]
[*][size=3]Choose where you want to place the stairs to the cellar.[/size]
[*][size=3]Optional small tweak to remove columns on both summit house or cellars.[/size]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Dependencies:[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286][size=3]Ridgeside Village[/size][/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915][size=3]Content Patcher[/size][/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][size=3]Generic Mod Config Menu[/size][/url]
[/list]
